changelog.name: v1.1.4
changelog.body: Add long-press multi-select in the Apps tab for batch Allow/Restrict presets and policy reset.

changelog.name: v1.1.3
changelog.body:
Complete cloud whitelist parsing and ColorOS 16 hooks for account sync, service restart, and keep-alive controls.
Add customizable allow and restrict preset split buttons, and move policy reset actions to the top bar without altering suspend state.
Fix LazyColumn RectList crash by upgrading Compose and Material 3 and removing conflicting list item size animations.

changelog.name: v1.1.1
changelog.body:
Fix intermittent LSPosed service disconnection when reopening the app within an existing process.
Fix Doze policy reverting to Follow System leaving persistent changes in the system whitelist.
Refine app detail layout with unified policy, freeze control, and dispatch log cards.

changelog.name: v1.1.0
changelog.body:
Strengthen ColorOS 16 background enforcement and add local runtime status.
Add a Processes tab for process monitoring with optional Root view.
Add multi-user and App Clone support.
Add pm suspend freeze control, auto-suspend with configurable delay, and smart unsuspend on launch.

changelog.name: v1.0.1
changelog.body:
Fix inaccurate reading of recent task lock and memory protection lists on ColorOS 16.
Restore system forbid-lock list detection when legacy XML files are empty.

# ColorOSBgManager

[![Xposed](https://img.shields.io/badge/-Xposed-green?style=flat&logo=Android&logoColor=white)](#)
[![GitHub all releases](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/Xposed-Modules-Repo/io.github.yukino1111.colorosbgmanager/total?label=Downloads)](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/io.github.yukino1111.colorosbgmanager/releases)

适配 ColorOS 16 的后台应用管理模块，支持对墓碑、自启与关联启动、电池/Doze、Athena 内存清理、CPU 限核、Doze 限网及广播限流按应用单独放行或管控，并支持自动冻结（pm suspend）、智能解冻及进程监控。

模块仅作自用分享。

## 测试环境

> ColorOS 16

## 使用方法

1. 在 LSPosed 中启用模块
2. 勾选作用域
3. 重启设备

## 免责声明

- 修改系统后台调度、墓碑冻结、限核、断网与广播限流策略可能影响消息推送、应用保活或功耗表现，**请谨慎调整并自行评估影响；**
- **本项目仅供个人学习、研究与自用分享**，因使用本模块造成的任何设备故障、数据丢失或异常，**作者概不承担责任**。

## 致谢

本模块思路与部分拦截逻辑借鉴自以下开源项目：  
[io.github.marukon.nohansfreeze](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/io.github.marukon.nohansfreeze)
